HEADER: Init +6; Senses Dragon senses, smoke vision; Perception +19
DEFENSE: AC 23, touch 11, flat-footed 21 (+2 dex, +12 natural, -1 size)
DR 5/magic; Immune Fire, Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Ice 50%
OFFENSE: Melee Bite +18 (2d6+10), 2 Claws +18 (1d8+7), 2 Wings +13 (1d6+3), Tail Slap +13 (1d8+10)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks Breath Weapon (40-ft. cone, 6d10 fire damage, Reflex DC 20 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Fire Roar, Fireball, Healing Flame
At will - bleed, detect magic, ignite, mending, message, read magic, torchlight
2nd (DC 13) - detonate II, elemental resistance, fire II, see invisibility
3rd (DC 14) - detonate III, dispel, fira, fire III, haste
4th (DC 20) - blaze spikes, fire IV, volcanic storm
STATISTICS: Str 25, Dex 15, Con 19, Int 12, Wis 20, Cha 12
Base Atk +12; CMB +20; CMD 32 (36 vs. trip)
Feats Cleave, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Power Attack, Vital Strike
Skills Appraise +15, Bluff +15, Fly +11, Intimidate +15, Perception +19, Spellcraft +15, Stealth +13
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Fire Roar (su) Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a red dragon roars a fiery cone blast within 30-ft. burst. Any creature within the area of effect takes 10d6 points of fire damage and are inflicted with the Burn status effect for 1d6 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 21) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

Fireball (su) As a standard action within 840 ft., a red dragon generates a searing explosion of flame that detonates with a low roar and deals 5d8 points of fire damage to every creature within the 20-ft.-radius. Every creature caught in the explosion must make a Reflex save (DC 21) to take half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

Healing Flame (su) Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, the red dragon manifests a sacred flame beneath his foe up to 30 feet away, dealing 6d6 points of damage (half holy/fire) and heals himself for half the damage dealt. The target must make a successful Fortitude save (DC 21) to take half damage and the red dragon does not gain any hit points. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).
Smoke Vision (ex) A red dragon can see perfectly in smoky conditions.

curation.summary: Juvenile Red Dragon is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 38 generated item(s) across 7 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
